kv_pool.note: ENGINE-ANCHORED RECONSTRUCTION (the GT's own engine log was overwritten 05-22; full verbatim excerpts committed at profile_data/engine_logs/2080ti_Llama-3.1-8B_tp1_pool_evidence.txt, L10-tp1sub20 2026-06-11): same-host same-model same-util tp1 ENGINE POOL LINE 2080ti:/tmp/calib_2080ti_test.log (04-29, vllm 0.19.0, enforce_eager, max_model_len=4096, util 0.85): 'GPU KV cache size: 23,600 tokens' / 'Available KV cache memory: 2.88 GiB' -> 1475 blocks at zero CUDA-graph estimate. The GT config (non-eager, max_model_len=8192, util 0.85, VLLM_MEMORY_PROFILER_ESTIMATE_CUDAGRAPHS=1 via sweep_multiturn_profiles.sh) differs only by the CG estimate (profile_run activation peak is max_num_batched_tokens=2048-bound, max_len-insensitive); the same-model tp1 CG estimate from the 3090 anchor log (3090:/tmp/vllm_8093.log 06-02: equiv-util 0.8500->0.8277 on 25,769,803,776 B) is 0.575e9 B (actual capture 0.48 GiB, consistent). pool = 3.093e9 - 0.575e9 = 2.519e9 B / 2,097,152 B-per-block = 1201 blocks (19,216 tokens). HARD ENGINE BRACKETS [512, 1475]: >= 512 (vLLM v1 startup check at max_model_len 8192, vllm/v1/core/kv_cache_utils.py check_enough_kv_cache_memory), <= 1475 (the zero-CG eager ceiling above); residual uncertainty is only the Ampere->Turing transfer of the tp1 CG estimate (<= 1.88 GiB by the startup bound). Cross-checks: three independent same-host engine logs decompose to ~0.83 GiB non-CG overhead (tp1-eager 0.83 / tp2 0.82 / tp4 0.82); the tp2-sibling overhead transfer (3.29 GB) gives 347 < the 512 startup bound -> falsified. Replaces the L9 512-block startup-feasibility LOWER-BOUND pin (which priced mass eviction/serialized admission: chat TTFT +87% at c10); the kv_pool.py rule gives 247 (provably too small). Hand-pinned: regeneration via generate_deployments would revert to the rule value. Successor: capture the exact tp1 engine line at GT flags (one server start, next host window).

scheduler.note: ENGINE-CONFIG TRUTH for the TTFT queue-sim admission arithmetic (QSimSchedConfig; L10-tp1sub20 round 2). VERBATIM EVIDENCE: (1) GT server metadata (every bench JSON config block, e.g. chat-multiturn-synth_conc10.json): 'max_model_len': 8192, 'max_num_batched_tokens': None, 'max_num_seqs': None -> both scheduler caps ran at vLLM resolved defaults.
